The compatibility images include mariadb-dump from MariaDB 11.8.6. Crafted database object names or values can produce SQL injection in a dump when it is subsequently imported. Upstream fixes this in MariaDB 11.8.9, while the available Debian trixie client package remains based on 11.8.6. Client-package remediation and validation remain under investigation; this is not a claim that the dump utility is unaffected. See https://github.com/MariaDB/server/security/advisories/GHSA-wxr3-wm3p-7w6p and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-86047

WBITT Network Multitool ships MariaDB client utilities and Connector/C, without the MariaDB server executable, embedded-server library, server plugins, or server systemd service. The vulnerable functionality is server GRANT PROXY authorization, which is not present in the client payload. This assessment does not cover mariadb-dump quoting issues. See https://github.com/MariaDB/server/security/advisories/GHSA-625w-4hgq-qwmr
